title: Inside Praktika's conversational approach to language learning
summary: How Praktika uses GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.2 to build adaptive AI tutors that personalize lessons, track progress, and help learners achieve real-world language fluency
body: How Praktika uses GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.2 to build adaptive AI tutors that personalize lessons, track progress, and help learners achieve real-world language fluency
summaryZh: 本文剖析了语种学习应用Praktika如何利用OpenAI的GPT-4.1和GPT-5.2模型，打造高度个性化的自适应AI语言家教系统。该应用能够根据学习者的实时表现调整教学内容、追踪学习进度，并辅导用户在真实世界场景中实现语言流利度，是LLM在教育科技垂直领域深度落地的标杆案例。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该案例研究了Praktika如何利用GPT-4.1和GPT-5.2构建自适应AI语言家教，展示了LLM在教育领域的深度定制与对话式应用。
